root_cause_candidates.proof_needed: Trusted deadline arm/fire and interrupt/kill provenance for the matching run/thread/turn; a model sentence or approximately 60-second duration is insufficient.
Matching turn/completed with turn.status=completed and independently verified remaining work. This proves normal early completion, not the model's internal motivation.
Causal typed quota/throttle/session-budget error and observable account or controller budget state; preserve distinct subtypes and unknown coverage.
Correlated tool item, structured error, willRetry, subprocess status and terminal causal chain. Recoverable test failures are not automatically terminal tool failures.
Complete client trace showing normal turn end, verified eligible frontier and no subsequent dispatch; compare matched native and raw App Server cohorts.
Matched D/E/F trials with the same fixture, authority and runtime but controlled checkpoint/window instructions. Existing source wording alone does not establish causation.
Observe context/session budget, hooks/goals, pending input, policy errors, sleep/wake, transport and schema/runtime changes; otherwise retain UNKNOWN.

minimum_supervisor: One local Mac process owning a process-held exclusive lock, protected SQLite journal and budgets, a pinned Codex App Server stdio connection, one persistent thread and one active turn, an independently verified admitted task frontier, and the only terminal output channel. After turn/completed it reconciles state and issues the next turn/start on the same idle thread when work is safe and resources remain. Crash-surviving continuation additionally requires an actually installed OS process supervisor and tested recovery.
can_current_codex_ui_auto_continue: Current official documentation describes native /goal and synchronous Stop-hook continuation on supported surfaces/builds. Availability and configuration in the reported installation are unverified. Prompt-only enforcement and a hook's ability to continue do not establish this project's strict durable-state/terminal-output gate; suppressOutput is documented as unimplemented. The proposed guarantee applies only to a controller-owned output boundary, not another open native UI. Use exactly one continuation driver.

implementation_stages.deliverable: Installed-runtime/schema/config preflight and isolated useful fixture
implementation_stages.exit_evidence: Pinned receipts and negative sandbox probe protecting controller state and acceptance checks.

implementation_stages.deliverable: Passive recorder and causal terminal classifier
implementation_stages.exit_evidence: Synthetic replay coverage for terminal causes, races, lost ACKs and unknown events; model text cannot mint timeout evidence.
At least 12 consecutive trials in a completed cohort, exact evidence-backed category or explicit UNKNOWN for every observation, and matched native/App Server cohorts when available.
At least 10 useful consecutive accepted turns/task units with zero Owner Continue messages, persistent budgets, one active turn and one verified final or honest park.

implementation_stages.deliverable: Crash recovery and separately authorized local startup supervisor
implementation_stages.exit_evidence: Orphan quiescence, same-run recovery, cancellation/budget persistence, ambiguous-dispatch reconciliation and actual installed restart behaviour.
Per-effect authorization, intent/receipt and reconciliation tests before expanding beyond reversible local work; not a prerequisite for S3.

owner_decisions_required.decision: Approve the controller-owned execution/output surface and exact initial local workspace/action scope, unless already covered by an existing explicit grant.
owner_decisions_required.needed_before: deployment or admission of real work

owner_decisions_required.decision: Approve finite resource ceilings, handling of unobservable usage and any permitted runtime/model substitutions; proposed pilot values are not spending authorization.
owner_decisions_required.needed_before: live experiments or supervised work consuming approved resources

owner_decisions_required.decision: Approve local journal privacy/retention and any login/background startup installation; genuine credential or OS-consent steps remain separate external-permission events.

safety_contract.execution_window_limit_assignment: Controller only, with matching trusted external runtime evidence.
safety_contract.budget_scope: Persistent per run and stable obligation; new turns, replans and restarts do not reset consumption.
safety_contract.unknown_effect_replay: Prohibited until authoritative reconciliation establishes a safe next action.
